sources.snippet: Train our Retinexformer and MST++ with the distributed data parallel (DDP) strategy of pytorch on the NTIRE 2024 Low-Light Enhancement dataset. Please note that we use the mix-precision strategy in the training process, which is controlled by the bool hyperparameter use_amp in the config file.

sources.snippet: The model incorporates Transformer-based attention mechanisms to effectively handle both global and local features. For more details, see RetinexFormer Architecture. MST++ Architecture MST++ (Mask-guided Spectral-wise Transformer) was originally designed for hyperspectral image reconstruction but has been adapted for low-light enhancement.
